title: Holding More Than One TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Block
content:
**Rule.** A client may hold any number of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours blocks, of the same or of different sizes, at the same time. There is no limit on the number of blocks one client holds. Each block keeps its own price, validity period, balance and settings, and blocks are combined only by the order in which hours are drawn across the client's blocks.

| Question | Answer under the rule |
|---|---|
| May a client holding a TimeBank 40-Hour Block buy a second 40-Hour Block? | Yes; any number of blocks of the same size may be held. |
| May a client hold a 20-Hour Block and a 160-Hour Block together? | Yes; sizes may be mixed. |
| Does a second block share the first block's expiry date or balance? | No; each block keeps its own price, validity period, balance and settings. |
| Where do the blocks meet? | Only in the draw order, which decides which block a session's hours come from. |
